item.title: Works
item.description:
A list of personal projects. See each blog post for the full story behind them.

Live

Nomina!

A multilingual animal encyclopedia web app for kids. Tap an illustration to hear its name, and record your own voice (or your child's) to build a personalized encyclopedia. Fully static with no backend; recordings stay on-device only.

TypeScript SvelteKit TailwindCSS PWA
Live demo GitHub Development story (JP) Official X
In progress

IoT Environmental Control System "Nautls"

An in-house IoT environmental control system aimed at autonomous smart agriculture. Full-stack IoT development spanning both software and hardware.
